A field with two shapes reads as an inconsistency and the obvious tidy-up is to force one — which is exactly the breaking read this decision declined. The two mutations ARE those two tidy-ups, one per direction, because each is a plausible edit that no within-shape fixture would catch. Both plant into vendor-register; ai-register's copy is held to the same behaviour by CAC-TW-1, which runs both walks over both shapes.
